releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.1.7

Hubble 1.1.7: TSL tally and automatic router switching

Add TSL 3.1 and 5.0 receivers over UDP and TCP, with live discovery and per-camera tally mappings.

Add TALLY Switch (BETA) to follow program tally on router outputs, hold routes through dissolves, and save following controls with each workspace.

Add Button Tally controls, configurable feedback colors, and animated Companion glow. Includes Companion module 0.3.3.

Refine spreadsheet selection and live-test feedback, and improve local DIT Browse connection discovery.
